name: Troll Necklace Bounty
summary: For Fraggar Thundermantle, troll tribal necklaces still come in batches of five. The Wildhammer has already accepted one batch from you, and the offer remains open.

sections.title: A Standing Offer
sections.body: Fraggar Thundermantle welcomes more troll tribal necklaces whenever you find them and choose to hand them over. He says the Wildhammers will fight for those who fight for them. Each batch must hold five necklaces.

sections.title: Fraggar's Approval
sections.body: Fraggar Thundermantle is pleased when you bring him the necklaces. To him, they prove you are willing to get your hands dirty, a quality the Wildhammers prize.

faq.q: Who wants the troll tribal necklaces?
faq.answer: Fraggar Thundermantle speaks for the Wildhammers.

faq.q: How many troll tribal necklaces are needed?
faq.answer: Five at a time. Fraggar counts a batch only when it holds five necklaces.

faq.q: Why does Fraggar Thundermantle collect these necklaces?
faq.answer: Fraggar treats the necklaces as proof that you are willing to fight for the Wildhammers. He says they will fight for those who do.
You already completed the first Troll Necklace Bounty for Fraggar Thundermantle.
